# Esan Electric Company

> Wholesale supplier of fans, wires & cables, LED lighting, MCB switchgear and water heaters for retail shops, dealers, contractors and builders in Tamil Nadu, India. Prices are quoted on request.

## What we sell
- Fans: ceiling (standard, BLDC, designer, high-speed), exhaust, table and pedestal fans
- Wires & cables: copper house wire by the roll and in bulk
- Lighting: LED bulbs, tube lights, downlights and battens
- MCB & switchgear: MCBs, MCCBs, RCCBs, isolators and distribution boards
- Water heaters

## Who we supply
- Retail shops and dealers restocking in wholesale lots
- Contractors and builders needing project quantities
- Service area: Tamil Nadu only

## How to buy
Request rates via the enquiry form, phone +91 72005 23519, WhatsApp https://wa.me/917200523519, or email boseelectrical.karaikal@gmail.com. We reply within an hour.
